files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 as a web-app with main.jac as entry point and app at /. The client runtime dependencies are provided by Jac. No backend, AI service, shadcn package, or additional npm dependency is required.
Provide readable fleet registry and status styles for the single-page UI.

Implement the FleetModule component: six demo vehicle records, status counts (total 6, active 4, maintenance 1, idle 1), a status filter, visible-row count, and a table with each vehicle's plate, type, driver, status, fuel, speed, and location. VehicleRow may be a private helper in this module. Keep controls limited to the requested behavior.
Import FleetModule, load styles.css, and expose public app() -> JsxElement that mounts the fleet registry at /.

verify.steps: Run jac check and jac build. Use a real browser to verify six initial rows and filter actions yielding active 4, maintenance 1, idle 1 with no page errors.

assumption: The source module is pages/dashboard/FleetModule.jac at commit 98f7832. The original source repo has a broken root route in available Jac versions, so the working reference is that unchanged module mounted in a minimal Jac 0.36.1 wrapper.
